_comment: A cleartext send whose host is built at run time (`http://${server}/api`): the scan resolves the "http://" prefix, so remote and cleartext are known while the host is not. The response is item-free, so it renders with no subject to fill and all three sends collapse into ONE entry with a locus each - the destination as the developer wrote it, including the template literal. Naming the host in the message instead would split the entry per host and render a null message, crashing the text report and putting a reason-less error into the JSON upload filter.
